profile.headline: Engineering at Defense Unicorns 🦄
profile.summary: I’m a professional with over 10 years working on multiple phases of the software lifecycle.  Most recently focused in the SRE & DevOps space with Kubernetes and other AWS & Azure services. I’m a life-long learner with an innate curiosity and demonstrated history pursuing knowledge to better solve problems.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description: Supported several services in production on Azure Kubernetes Service and AWS ECS with focuses on monitoring, automation, and incident response. Established monitoring and alerting using Prometheus and PagerDuty. Implemented and maintaining IaC solutions with Terraform incorporating with cloud pipelines to automate infrastructure deployment.

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description: Led the design, development, and implementation of an integration testing harness in Python using pytest for ArcGIS Velocity, Esri’s real-time and big data capability for their cloud GIS platform.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: Responsible for conducting research on climate change vulnerability to threatened and endangered Tennessee plants. Developed Python scripts and ArcGIS script tools to automate the quantitative GIS component of Natureserve’s Climate Change Vulnerability Index (CCVI). Produced reference maps for potential study sites incorporating collected GPS data.

positions.title: Biological Science Technician
positions.description: Responsible for collection of water data, management of water monitoring equipment in conjunction with USGS infrastructure, and authoring of documents surrounding monitoring efforts.  This included Standard operating procedures (SOP), job hazard analyses, and journal articles.
